adjacency: Replace all local records of one driver across the training horizon, conditional on identical public participation schedule, client roster, public covariates and other drivers records. A per-round clipped mean has replacement sensitivity 2C/n_t. Membership/participation is not protected.
noise_seed: Independent OS-entropy secret per run; never seed42. Persisted only inside access-restricted trusted resume state; same state resumes deterministically.
accounting: Gaussian RDP alpha/(2*sigma^2), additive576-round composition, epsilon=min_alpha(RDP+log(1/delta)/(alpha-1)); sigma measured relative to 2C/n_t. NO_SUBSAMPLING_AMPLIFICATION.
release_boundary: Noisy global model transcript only. Existing non-private baseline, unnoised validation metrics, clipping norm aggregates, training logs, client optimizer/buffer state and noise RNG are NOT DP releases. Entire repository/report is NOT protected by model-only accounting. Trusted research diagnostics are not publishable as a DP-protected data release.
trusted_state: Model namespaces mode0700, resume mode0600. Never distribute trusted_resume.pkl. Permission bits are not cryptographic protection or secure aggregation.
floating_point_limitation: Ideal Gaussian RDP accountant with NumPy float64 normal sampling and float32 model postprocessing; no hardened finite-precision DP sampler audit. Research mechanism, not a certified production privacy system.
